Poolish Baguette Baker's Percentage

Mix a pourable preferment ahead of time. Its weight belongs in the starter field, on top of the flour in the final dough.

Detailed method

Baguettes with a poolish in the starter field, weighed on top of the flour. Currently 500 g flour, 68% hydration, 33% poolish, 2% salt, and 0.2% yeast. That is 340 g water, 165 g poolish, 10 g salt, and 1 g yeast, 1016 g of dough. The poolish is 100% hydration, the same assumption used for effective hydration. The page shows 72.5% effective hydration. Currently 4 sticks of 254 g. Mix the poolish the day before. These times assume you only change the flour amount and keep the percentages the same. Still judge the dough by how it looks and feels.

  1. Poolish Mix 82.5 g flour, 82.5 g water, and a pinch (about 0.1 g) of instant yeast. Leave it covered at room temperature for 8 to 12 hours, until it is bubbly and about doubled. That 165 g poolish is the starter field, on top of the 500 g flour in the final dough. The final dough still uses 1 g instant yeast.
  2. Mix Stir 500 g flour, 340 g water, the 165 g poolish, 1 g instant yeast, and 10 g salt until no dry flour remains. At 68% the dough is soft. Aim for about 24°C (75°F).
  3. Bulk Cover it at about 24°C (75°F) for about 2 to 3 hours. Fold it twice in the first hour. It is ready when it has grown by about half.
  4. Shape Divide the 1016 g into 4 pieces of 254 g. Rest 20 minutes, then roll each piece into a stick about 35 cm long. The default 1016 g uses a rimmed tray about 40 cm long, 30 cm wide, and 2 cm high, or a stone about 40 cm long. If you change the amount, use a tray sized to fit, or bake in batches.
  5. Proof Cover the sticks for 40 to 60 minutes, until they look puffy. The poolish does most of the rise, and the 0.2% yeast finishes it.
  6. Bake Heat the oven to 240°C (465°F). Score each stick on a diagonal three or four times. Bake 20 to 25 minutes with steam, until the crust is golden and the scores have opened. If you have no steam, set a small tray of hot water on the bottom rack. Cool on a rack.
